recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Future pronouns ValueSet corrections should be made in the current terminology source of truth rather than by reintroducing inactive core source.
issue_request: FHIR-39676 was a Published/Persuasive PA issue for R5 requesting that the LA29520-6 display in the pronouns value set match the LOINC answer list exactly: "they/them/their/theirs/themselves" instead of "They, Them, Their, Theirs, Themself."
initial_application: No direct FHIR-39676-tagged commit exists in core. Core commit f3c0d3659c moved the relevant Gender Harmony pronouns terminology out of core before the issue was resolved. Extension Pack commit 8367feb then applied FHIR-39676 by changing the LOINC pronouns ValueSet displays, including LA29520-6, to the slash-separated LOINC forms.
additional_context: Current core source has no active pronouns value set entry in source/fhir.ini and no LA29520-6 value set content to edit. The Extension Pack later removed ValueSet-pronouns.xml in 7e35b16 because the terminology resources moved to THO, and the current THO ValueSet/pronouns publication has LA29520-6 displayed as "they/them/their/theirs/themselves."
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No FHIR core source change is appropriate because the target ValueSet is outside this checkout and the current externally maintained terminology publication already has the requested display.
